consequence.statement: Before upgrading to Cilium 1.16.0, environments using external workloads must ensure the cluster has a name and ID specified, or must explicitly opt out of KVStoreMesh which is now enabled by default.

assertion.statement: Cilium 1.16.0 enables KVStoreMesh by default; if external workloads are in use, the cluster must have name and ID configured before upgrade, or KVStoreMesh must be explicitly disabled.
